## Type of contribution

- [ ] Critique — an argument here is weak, or a border can be argued around
- [ ] Evidence — a source for or against an empirical claim, or a claim that is outdated
- [ ] Test result — a negotiation scenario run against current models
- [ ] Fix — typo, broken link, formatting
- [ ] Other:

## Checklist

These mirror the rules in [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/richardkfm/homonoia/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md), which mirror the rules the documents follow.

- [ ] **Honest.** No overstatement. Uncertainty is marked. Test setups are distinguished from real-world incidents.
- [ ] **Strongest version first.** Positions I disagree with are stated at their best before I criticize them.
- [ ] **Sourced.** Empirical claims link to a source.
- [ ] **Versioned.** Every document I changed has its version bumped and a changelog line added.
- [ ] **AI assistance disclosed** below, if any was used.
